setDescription: Demo set of what-if scenarios for the Breda five-value scan — the four variants from the congress story (slides 'Next 1') plus the tree sensitivity test

scenarios.name: Heat attention doubled above 25% aged 65+
scenarios.provenanceNote: paved share counts double where the 65+ share exceeds 25%

scenarios.name: Neighbourhood deals as a hard democratic floor
scenarios.provenanceNote: mean → minimum of accessibility and deals

scenarios.name: Green coverage doubled in spatial value

basis.rationale: exploration: no policy document weighs green coverage heavier than green distance and trees

scenarios.name: Spatial value without the tree counter

basis.rationale: sensitivity test without a policy basis: the tree layer counts public green only, so dropping it shows how much the spatial score depends on that single source

scenarios.provenanceNote: sensitivity test — not a documented policy choice
